name: YapTap
tagline: Hold a key, talk, let go. Fully local dictation.
description: Free, open-source dictation that runs entirely on your computer. Hold a key, speak, and clean text appears wherever your cursor is. Speech recognition runs locally with NVIDIA Parakeet or OpenAI Whisper: no cloud, no account, no word limits.
highlights: Hold or tap to dictate in any app
